research_brief.object: Declared relativistic robotic or crewed mission architecture
research_brief.central_hypothesis: A coupled mission model yields a narrower and better calibrated subluminal feasible region than energy-only screening.
alternative_explanations: Energy-only limits dominate all other constraints in a defined regime.
Improved materials or external infrastructure alters a current feasibility boundary.
A model disagreement is caused by reference-frame or unit inconsistency rather than a physical effect.
falsification_conditions: Validated architecture outside predicted feasible envelope.
No predictive improvement over energy-only baseline.
Independent component data contradict coupled module estimates beyond declared uncertainty.

risk_register.risk: Misreading a flyby as a rendezvous mission
risk_register.mitigation: Mandatory braking field and incomplete-state rule.
Separate proxy labels from qualification claims and require human-supervised validation.
No automatic hardware operation; facility and safety approval required.
Hard special-relativity invariant and frozen-source restriction.
